title: The anisotropic Calderón problem for Riemannian metrics at high fixed frequency
summary: We study an inverse boundary value problem for the Helmholtz equation on a smooth compact non-trapping Riemannian manifold with strictly convex boundary. We prove that, given two such metrics, for sufficiently large but fixed frequency $λ$, equality of their Dirichlet-to-Neumann maps implies equality of their lens data, up to a smooth boundary-fixing diffeomorphism. This establishes a high-frequency bridge between the Calderón problem and lens rigidity.
